info.description: Interactive API documentation for OH's Media Generation APIs

post.description: Create a new conversation room for a customer-character pair. The returned room_id should be used for all subsequent text, image, audio, and video requests.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/rooms' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{
    "user_gender": "male",
    "character_id": "154"
  }'

import requests
import json

url = 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/rooms'
headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY',
    
}
data = {
    'user_gender': 'male',
    'character_id': '154'
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

user_gender.description: Gender of the user (e.g., male, female)

texting_style.description: Optional reply register for this room. 'default' (used when omitted) keeps the existing production style; 'short-form' is a brief, punchy chat-speak register; 'long-form' is a warm, natural register. Can be changed later via PATCH /api/v1/rooms/{room_id}/texting-style.

room_id.description: Unique identifier for the created room

put.description: Set the reply register for an existing room. 'default' keeps the production style every room starts with; 'short-form' is a brief, punchy chat-speak register; 'long-form' is a warm, natural register. Takes effect from the next generated reply (text and audio). Rooms created before this feature behave as 'default'.

texting_style.description: Reply register for the room. Applies from the next generated reply (text and audio).

200.description: Room updated; returns the room view including the new texting_style

patch.description: Set the reply register for an existing room. 'default' keeps the production style every room starts with; 'short-form' is a brief, punchy chat-speak register; 'long-form' is a warm, natural register. Takes effect from the next generated reply (text and audio). Rooms created before this feature behave as 'default'.

texting_style.description: Reply register for the room. Applies from the next generated reply (text and audio).

200.description: Room updated; returns the room view including the new texting_style

post.description: Generate an image of the character. This is an asynchronous operation — submit the request, receive a job_id and presigned_url, then poll GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/status until the job completes. The presigned_url will contain the generated image once the job status is "completed".

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/images' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{
    "character_id": "154",
    "prompt": "A stunning selfie at sunset on the beach",
    "prompt_enhancement": false,
    "resolution": "9:16"
  }'

import requests

response = requests.post(
    'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/images',
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY'},
    json={
        'character_id': '154',
        'prompt': 'A stunning selfie at sunset on the beach',
        'prompt_enhancement': False,
        'resolution': '9:16'
    }
)
result = response.json()
job_id = result['job_id']
presigned_url = result['presigned_url']
print('Job ID:', job_id)
print('Download URL:', presigned_url)

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate

prompt_enhancement.description: When enabled, the system enhances your prompt using AI to improve image quality and detail. When disabled, your prompt is used as-is.

user_gender.description: Gender of the user. Used to tailor the generated scene when prompt enhancement is enabled. If omitted, defaults to the opposite of the character's gender.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Can be an aspect ratio string ("9:16", "16:9", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4") or an explicit [width, height] array. Aspect ratio presets map to: 9:16 → 720×1280, 16:9 → 1280×720, 1:1 → 1024×1024, 4:3 → 960×720, 3:4 → 720×960.

example.prompt: A stunning selfie at sunset on the beach

job_id.description: Unique identifier for tracking job status

presigned_url.description: S3 presigned URL where the image will be available

get.description: Poll this endpoint to check the status of an asynchronous job (image generation or text-to-video). Use the job_id received from the generation response. For image-to-video jobs, use GET /api/v1/videos/get instead. Recommended polling interval: every 2–5 seconds, with a maximum timeout of 5 minutes.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/status' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY'

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The job ID returned from image generation request

url.description: Presigned download URL for the generated content. Only present when status is "completed".

results.description: Additional result data. May contain "image_prompt" (the enhanced prompt that was used) when prompt_enhancement was enabled.

image_prompt.description: The enhanced prompt that was actually used for generation (only present if prompt_enhancement was enabled)

error.description: Error message. Only present when status is "failed".

results.image_prompt: A photograph of the character at sunset...

post.description: Saves an AI character from Postgres to Drupal MySQL and updates the Postgres record with the Drupal ID. The characterId from the generate step is required.

patch.description: Partially update an existing character's attributes. Only include fields you want to change.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X PATCH 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/characters/737' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{
    "firstName": "Sophia",
    "lastName": "Martinez",
    "biography": "A creative artist from Barcelona",
    "dateOfBirth": "1995-06-15"
  }'

import requests

url = 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/characters/737'
headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY'
}
data = {
    'firstName': 'Sophia',
    'lastName': 'Martinez',
    'biography': 'A creative artist from Barcelona',
    'dateOfBirth': '1995-06-15'
}

response = requests.patch(url, headers=headers, json=data)
print(response.json())

parameters.name: characterId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the character (integer or UUID)

schema.description: Character fields to update. All fields are optional. Only include fields you want to change. Enum fields must use values from the allowed list — use the taxonomy endpoints to retrieve valid options.

biography.example: A creative artist from Barcelona with a passion for modern art

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD). Age will be calculated and must be 21+

voiceId.description: S3 URI for the voice reference audio

success.description: Indicates if the update was successful

updatedFields.description: List of field names that were modified

message.example: Validation failed: dateOfBirth must be a valid ISO date string

post.description:
Generate a video asynchronously. Supports two modes:

**Image-to-Video (i2v):** Provide an `imageUrl` and a `category` to animate an existing image with a specific motion/position. You must also provide a `videoPath` for the output location. Poll `GET /api/v1/videos/get?videoId={id}` for status.

**Text-to-Video (t2v):** Provide a `character_id` and a `prompt` — the system generates a starting image from the character and animates it automatically. Poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/status` for status.

x-code-samples.source:
# Image-to-Video
curl -X POST 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/videos/create' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/my-image.jpg",
    "prompt": "Riding motion with bouncing",
    "category": "cowgirl",
    "videoPath": "videos/my-customer/1234567890-5s.mp4",
    "videoLength": 5
  }'

# Text-to-Video
curl -X POST 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/videos/create' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -d '{
    "character_id": "154",
    "prompt": "Waving at the camera and smiling",
    "length": 5,
    "resolution": "9:16"
  }'

import requests

# Image-to-Video
i2v = requests.post(
    'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/videos/create',
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY'},
    json={
        'imageUrl': 'https://example.com/my-image.jpg',
        'prompt': 'Riding motion with bouncing',
        'category': 'cowgirl',
        'videoPath': 'videos/my-customer/1234567890-5s.mp4',
        'videoLength': 5
    }
).json()
# Poll: GET /api/v1/videos/get?videoId={i2v['id']}

# Text-to-Video
t2v = requests.post(
    'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v1/videos/create',
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY'},
    json={
        'character_id': '154',
        'prompt': 'Waving at the camera and smiling',
        'length': 5,
        'resolution': '9:16'
    }
).json()
# Poll: GET /api/v1/jobs/{t2v['job_id']}/status

schema.description: Two modes are supported depending on which fields you provide. For image-to-video, provide `imageUrl`, `category`, and `videoPath`. For text-to-video, provide `character_id`.

prompt.description: Description of the video content or motion to generate.

imageUrl.description: **Image-to-Video mode.** URL of the source image to animate. Required for i2v mode.

category.description: **Image-to-Video mode.** Motion/position category for the video. Determines what kind of motion is applied to the source image. Required for i2v mode.

videoPath.description: **Image-to-Video mode.** S3 storage path for the output video (e.g., `videos/{customerId}/{timestamp}-5s.mp4`). Required for i2v mode.

videoLength.description: **Image-to-Video mode.** Video length in seconds. Must be 5, 10, or 15.

character_id.description: **Text-to-Video mode.** Character identifier. The system generates a starting image from the character and animates it.

image_url.description: **Text-to-Video mode.** Alternative to character_id — provide your own source image. The system will animate it based on the prompt with automatic action detection.

prompt_enhancement.description: **Text-to-Video mode.** When enabled, the system enhances your prompt using AI to improve video quality and motion. Enabled by default.

resolution.description: **Text-to-Video mode.** Output resolution. Can be an aspect ratio string or [width, height] array. Aspect ratio presets map to: 9:16 → 720×1800, 16:9 → 1280×720, 1:1 → 1024×1024, 4:3 → 960×720, 3:4 → 720×960.

length.description: **Text-to-Video mode.** Video length in seconds. Must be 5, 10, or 15.

post.description: Creates a new AI character with async profile generation. Returns immediately with 'generating' status. Poll the status endpoint until status is 'ready'.

x-code-samples.source:
# Example: pregnancy state + scar via additionalDescription.
curl -X POST 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v2/characters/generate' \
  -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\
    "firstName": "Aria",\
    "lastName": "Storm",\
    "biography": "A free-spirited artist with a passion for adventure",\
    "nationality": "American",\
    "ethnicity": "Caucasian",\
    "gender": "Female",\
    "additionalDescription": "six months pregnant, a faint scar across her left cheekbone"\
  }'

import requests

# Example: full-sleeve tattoo + nose piercing via additionalDescription.
url = 'https://api.oh.xyz/api/v2/characters/generate'
headers = {
    'x-api-key': 'YOUR_API_KEY',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
payload = {
    'firstName': 'Aria',
    'lastName': 'Storm',
    'biography': 'A free-spirited artist with a passion for adventure',
    'nationality': 'American',
    'ethnicity': 'Caucasian',
    'gender': 'Female',
    # Free-text addendum for the reference image. Trimmed; empty values skip moderation.
    'additionalDescription': 'full sleeve tattoo of cherry blossoms down her left arm, septum nose piercing',
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
if response.status_code == 400:
    print('Moderation:', response.json()['message'])
else:
    data = response.json()
    print('Character GUID:', data['characterGuid'])
